title: Polynomial-time computability of the test
statement: For every finite nondeterministic Turing machine $N$ over bits and natural numbers $c,B,e$, the function sending a bit string $x$ to the one-bit output containing the value of the test on $x$ is polynomial-time computable.
hypotheses_covered: $N$ is a finite nondeterministic Turing machine over bits
